title: Move evidence acquisition from browser crawl to a backend evidence service; keep recommendation client-side

alternatives: Move both evidence acquisition AND Wheelwright (recommendation) to the backend (rejected as initial approach)
Move only evidence acquisition, retain Wheelwright client-side (selected)
Use a third-party managed data platform (rejected)
rationale: Browser lifecycle is incompatible with long-lived background acquisition; server-side recommendation would destroy instant local recomputation; no platform provides the domain-specific evidence shape.
expected_consequences: Acquisition survives reloads; one authoritative evidence state; transactional SQLite; credentials server-side; multi-process local dev; snapshot payload/schema-evolution concerns.
